# Stage 4: hedonic baseline (generated by src/avm/stage4_hedonic.py)

Target = 2025 sale price at the Jan 1 2025 trend level, neutral season (Stage 3, evaluation only). Hedonic predicts at the Dec 2024 trend level, neutral month-of-year, from data through 2024. Cells: estimate [95% CI]; diffs are hedonic - assessor with paired bootstrap CIs (2,000 resamples). For COD and MdAPE a negative diff favors the hedonic. **PRD/PRB against sale prices lean regressive** (price noise in the denominator).

## Features (rule 7)

| feature | why | proxy note |
|---|---|---|
| l_area | log finished sq ft (roll Y-1) | size; no proxy concern |
| l_lot | log lot sq ft; lot_missing flags a filled median | size; no proxy concern |
| age_bin | sale year - year built, binned (roll Y-1) | building vintage; correlates with neighborhood history, monitored in Stage 8 |
| beds | bedrooms, clipped 1-7 (MPROP only, never the sales file) | no proxy concern |
| full_baths | full baths (2019+ rolls; 0 + baths_missing before) | no proxy concern |
| half_baths | half baths (as above) | no proxy concern |
| stories | stories category (1, 1.5, 2, 2.5+, missing) | no proxy concern |
| style | assessor building type code; codes with < 30 training sales -> other | no proxy concern |
| duplex | roll Y-1 land use 8820 | property type; no proxy concern |
| loc | location fixed effect: assessor neighborhood or census tract, units with < 30 training sales folded into the assessor region | LOCATION: allowed by rule 7 but can proxy for protected-class composition; equity audited in Stage 8 |
| age | numeric age (GBM; the hedonic uses age_bin) | as age_bin |
| stories_num | numeric stories, NaN if missing (GBM) | no proxy concern |
| l_prior_total | log roll Y-1 total assessed value: ASSESSMENT-INFORMED variant only (rule 6) | inherits any bias in the assessor's values; equity audited in Stage 8 |
| l_prior_land | log roll Y-1 land assessed value: ASSESSMENT-INFORMED variant only | as l_prior_total |
| t | months since Jan 2014: market trend (spline in the hedonic) | time; no proxy concern |
| moy | month of year: seasonality (sum-to-zero; neutral at prediction) | time; no proxy concern |
